name: @tedix/desktop
description: Tedix desktop app: the Tedix OS chat in a window, the Tedix command-line tool, and a checklist that sets up this Mac.

scripts.compile: if [ -n "$DESKTOP_SOURCE_SHA" ]; then bun run bundle:local arm64 && bun run bundle:local x64 || exit; fi; bun build src/main.ts src/preload.ts src/local-model-preload.ts --outdir out --target node --format cjs --external electron --entry-naming '[name].cjs' && bun build src/settings.ts src/onboarding.ts src/update-button.ts src/question-window.ts src/input-bar.ts --outdir out --target browser && bun build src/local-model-chat.ts --outdir out --target browser --format iife && bun scripts/package-agent-plugins.ts
scripts.dev: bun run compile && node node_modules/electron/install.js && electron .
